questions: How long does a refund take?
When will I get my refund?
refund kab milega?
answer: Refunds are credited to your original payment method within 5-7 working days after we receive the returned item.

questions: How can I track my order?
Where can I see the status of my package?
mera order kahan tak pahuncha?
answer: Open My Orders, select the order and tap Track Package to see live courier updates.

questions: How do I cancel my order?
Can I cancel an order I just placed?
order cancel kaise karu?
answer: You can cancel from My Orders any time before the item is shipped. After shipping, please use the return option instead.

questions: What is your return policy?
How many days do I have to return a product?
kitne din tak return kar sakte hain?
answer: Most products can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused and in original packaging.

questions: How do I return an item?
What is the process to send back a product?
product wapas karne ka process kya hai?
answer: Go to My Orders, choose the item, tap Return, pick a reason and schedule a pickup. We collect it from your address.

questions: Is cash on delivery available?
Can I pay when the order arrives?
kya COD milta hai?
answer: Cash on delivery is available on most pin codes for orders up to Rs 50,000. You will see the option at checkout.

questions: How long does delivery take?
When will my order arrive?
delivery mein kitna time lagega?
answer: Metro cities usually get orders in 2-4 days and other locations in 5-7 days. The exact date shows at checkout.

questions: My payment failed but money was deducted, what should I do?
Money got debited but the order was not placed
payment fail ho gaya par paisa kat gaya
answer: Deducted amounts from failed payments are automatically refunded in 3-5 working days. If it takes longer, contact your bank with the transaction ID.

questions: How do I download my invoice?
Where can I get the GST bill for my purchase?
invoice kahan se download karu?
answer: Open My Orders, select the order and tap Download Invoice. It is available once the order is delivered.

questions: How can I change my delivery address?
Can I update the shipping address after ordering?
delivery ka address kaise badlu?
answer: You can edit the address from My Orders until the order is shipped. After that the address cannot be changed.

questions: How do I apply a coupon code?
Where do I enter a promo code?
coupon code kahan lagana hai?
answer: Add items to your cart, tap Apply Coupon on the cart page and enter the code. The discount appears in the price summary.

questions: How does the product warranty work?
Do the products come with a warranty?
warranty kaise milti hai?
answer: Eligible products carry the brand warranty shown on the product page. Keep your invoice, as it is needed to claim service.

questions: Can I exchange a product for a different size or colour?
How do I swap my item for another one?
size badalna hai, exchange ho sakta hai?
answer: Yes, choose Exchange on the item in My Orders within 7 days of delivery. The replacement is shipped once we collect the original.

questions: I received a damaged or wrong product, what now?
The item that arrived is defective
galat ya toota hua saaman aaya hai kya karu?
answer: Please raise a request in My Orders within 48 hours of delivery with photos. We will arrange a free pickup and send a replacement or refund.

questions: How do I reset my password?
I forgot my login password
password bhool gaya, kaise badlu?
answer: On the login page tap Forgot Password, enter your registered email or phone and follow the OTP steps.

questions: How can I contact customer support?
What is the way to talk to a support agent?
customer care se baat kaise karu?
answer: Use Help in the app to chat with us 24x7, or call the toll-free number listed on the Contact Us page between 9 AM and 9 PM.

questions: Do you offer EMI options?
Can I pay in monthly instalments?
kya EMI par saaman le sakte hain?
answer: No-cost EMI is available on select cards and products above Rs 3,000. Eligible plans are listed at checkout.

questions: What is the minimum order value for free shipping?
Above what amount is delivery free?
free delivery ke liye kitna order karna padega?
answer: Delivery is free on orders above Rs 499. Below that, a small shipping fee is added at checkout.

questions: How do I delete my account?
I want to close my account permanently
mujhe apna account delete karna hai
answer: Go to Account Settings, then Privacy, and choose Delete Account. Pending orders must be completed first.

questions: Do you deliver outside India?
Is international shipping available?
kya aap videsh mein delivery karte hain?
answer: Right now we deliver only within India. International shipping is not available.

questions: How do I use a gift card?
Where can I redeem my gift voucher?
gift card kaise use karte hain?
answer: At checkout choose Gift Card as the payment option, enter the card number and PIN, and the balance is applied to your order.

questions: Why is my order delayed?
My package has not arrived on the promised date
mera order late kyun ho raha hai?
answer: Delays can happen due to weather, high demand or courier issues. Check Track Package for the latest estimate and contact support if it is more than 3 days late.

questions: Can I change the payment method after placing an order?
Switch from card to cash on delivery for an existing order
order dene ke baad payment method badal sakte hain?
answer: Payment method cannot be changed after an order is placed. You can cancel it before shipping and place a new order.

questions: Is it safe to save my card details?
Are my saved cards secure on your app?
kya card details save karna safe hai?
answer: Cards are tokenised as per RBI rules, so your full card number is never stored on our servers. You can remove saved cards any time in Payment Settings.

questions: Can I get my refund as store credit instead of the bank?
Refund to wallet instead of my card
refund wallet mein mil sakta hai kya?
answer: Yes, choose Store Wallet as the refund destination while returning. Wallet refunds arrive instantly once the item is received.

questions: How do I get notified when an item is back in stock?
Can I be alerted when a sold out product returns?
out of stock product wapas aaye to kaise pata chalega?
answer: Tap Notify Me on the product page and we will send you an alert as soon as it is available again.

questions: How do I update my phone number or email?
Where can I change my contact details?
mobile number ya email kaise badlu?
answer: Go to Account Settings, then Profile. Changing a phone number or email needs an OTP verification.

questions: Are your products genuine?
Do you sell original branded items?
kya aapke products original hote hain?
answer: Yes. All products come from the brand or verified sellers, and every order is covered by our authenticity guarantee.

questions: How do I earn reward points?
How can I collect loyalty points on purchases?
reward points kaise milte hain?
answer: You earn 1 point for every Rs 100 spent. Points are added after the return window closes and can be used on future orders.

questions: What happens if I miss the delivery?
Courier came but I was not at home
agar delivery ke time ghar par na hoon to kya hoga?
answer: The courier will try again up to 2 more times. You can also reschedule from Track Package. After that the order returns to us.
